facts.fact: The Agence nationale de l'état civil (ANEC) deploys the system, and its director general said on 16 September 2026 that civil-status data are hosted in Senegal in a state-owned datacenter on three sites.

facts.fact: As of 16 September 2026 deployment was effective in the Dakar, Thiès, Louga, Diourbel, Fatick and Kaolack regions, with ANEC planning to extend it to Tambacounda the following month and to the southern regions in the last quarter of 2026.
